title: Trump Truth Social Post Before Tariff Pause: 'THIS IS A GREAT TIME TO BUY!!!'
description_short: Trump Truth Social Post Before Tariff Pause: 'THIS IS A GREAT TIME TO BUY!!!'
description_medium: Shortly before announcing the 90-day tariff pause on April 9, 2025, Trump posted on Truth Social that 'THIS IS A GREAT TIME TO BUY!!!' — a post that appeared to foreshadow the imminent policy reversal that sent stocks surging. The timing raised immediate and serious allegations of insider trading and market manipulation by a sitting president. Congressional Democrats and watchdog groups demanded investigations. Legal scholars noted such conduct by an ordinary citizen would constitute securities fraud.
description_long: Trump posted a message encouraging people to buy on Truth Social shortly before announcing a 90-day tariff pause on April 9, 2025. Stocks rose sharply after the policy reversal. The sequence prompted allegations of market manipulation and insider trading, and congressional Democrats and watchdog groups sought investigation. The timing is the documented basis for scrutiny: the president urged market participation before publicly changing a policy that affected prices. It does not, on its own, identify anyone who traded with confidential information or establish that Trump personally realized a trading profit. The supplied draft includes a legal assertion that ordinary citizens engaging in comparable conduct would commit securities fraud; the new explanation keeps that issue as a question raised by critics rather than a proven offense. The supported event records the public post, the tariff announcement and the resulting demands for oversight. It does not provide the final findings of an investigation.
